text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of each variant minus the physics core (negative: the variant is better), ERA5 as the weather, rows kept by the mask. The gap to XGBoost is +0.31. Grey line: same as the core. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of each variant minus the physics core (negative: the variant is better), ERA5
as the weather, rows kept by the mask. The gap to XGBoost is +0.31. Grey line: same as the
core. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 3 wind farms,
53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.
